title: Cropland Dsirtibution in Liuhe, northern China
gallery_text: Liuhe and its cropland share the same valley landscape instead of forming a clear city–country boundary. Rivers and contours show how both settlement and farming follow the flatter terrain.
description:
Sources: ESA WorldCover 2021 was created from satellite images to map global land cover. I use its cropland and built-up classes to show the relationship between farming and urban growth in Liuhe.
Copernicus DEM GLO-30 was created to map surface elevation. I use it to draw contours and show how terrain shapes urban and agricultural land.
OpenStreetMap provides the river and stream lines.
Projection: EPSG:4551
Precedent: I wanted to learn from Uncharted (like the simplicity)
